options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: certificate
options.description: Required for I(import) A valid signed certificate in PEM format (Base64 encoded) Includes the "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----" and "-----END CERTIFICATE-----" lines

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: common_name
options.description: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the current array For example, the common name for https://purearray.example.com is purearray.example.com, or *.example.com for a wildcard certificate This can also be the management IP address of the array or the shortname of the current array. Maximum of 64 characters If not provided this will default to the shortname of the array

options.name: country
options.description: The two-letter ISO code for the country where your organization is located

options.name: days
options.description: The number of valid days for the self-signed certificate being generated If not specified, the self-signed certificate expires after 3650 days.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: email
options.description: The email address used to contact your organization

options.name: export_file
options.description: Name of file to contain Certificate Signing Request when `status sign` Name of file to export the current SSL Certificate when `status export` File will be overwritten if it already exists

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: generate
options.description: Generate a new private key. If not selected, the certificate will use the existing key

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: intermeadiate_cert
options.description: Intermeadiate certificate provided by the CA

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key
options.description: If the Certificate Signed Request (CSR) was not constructed on the array or the private key has changed since construction the CSR, provide a new private key here

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_size
options.description: The key size in bits if you generate a new private key

options.name: locality
options.description: The full name of the city where your organization is located

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the SSL Certificate

options.name: org_unit
options.description: The department within your organization that is managing the certificate

options.name: organization
options.description: The full and exact legal name of your organization. The organization name should not be abbreviated and should include suffixes such as Inc, Corp, or LLC.

options.name: passphrase
options.description: Passphrase if the private key is encrypted

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: province
options.description: The full name of the state or province where your organization is located

options.name: state
options.description: Action for the module to perform I(present) will create or re-create an SSL certificate I(absent) will delete an existing SSL certificate I(sign) will construct a Certificate Signing request (CSR) I(export) will export the existing SSL certificate I(import) will import a CA provided certificate.

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).
